definitions.definition: w_eff = -1 - (1/3) d ln rho_4/d ln a

rho4.A_compact_coordinate_period: ASSUMPTION: the extra times are compact with a fixed coordinate period (closed time-like directions); rho_4 = E/(proper 3-volume) ~ E e^{-3 a4}
rho4.B_per_unit_extra_time_coordinate_volume: non-compact extra times; rho_4 = E/(proper 3-volume x extra-time coordinate volume) ~ E e^{-3 a4}
rho4.C_per_unit_proper_7_volume: rho_4 = E/(proper 7-volume) x (constant) ~ E b4^{-3/2} (equivalently per unit proper extra-time volume e^{-3 a4} b4^{3/2})

history: a4 = H x4 and b4(x4) = b4(0) e^((4/3) H x4) PRESCRIBED (test field, no back-reaction); beta = 4/3; slices a4 in [0, 2]; a = e^{a4 - a4_today}

series.status: E = 0 and X = 0 at every slice (the k = 0 brane zero modes have eps = 0 and no interaction): no energy, w undefined

condensate.ratio_w: w_c = u/(2 + u), u = lambda S/m = u_today e^(-2 (a4 - a4_today))
condensate.phantom_ratio_window: ratio < -1 iff -2 < u < -1 (attractive lambda S < 0; rho = m S (1 + u/2) > 0 iff m S > 0); |u| grows toward the past like e^(-2 (a4 - a4_today)), so for u < 0 the condensate energy E_c = m S0 (1 + u/2) reaches 0 at a4 = a4_today - (1/2) ln(2/|u_today|)
condensate.history: exact homogeneous solution for every a4(x4), b4(x4) (Revision/field_equations_a4, key b4, fields.condensate); the 3-space observer's expansion-inferred w_exp = -1 exactly on a4 = H x4

expansion_inferred.statement: on the history a4 = H x4 (with b4(x4) = b4(0) e^((4/3) H x4)) the 3-space observer's Hubble rate a4' = H is constant (b4 does not enter a = e^{a4}): the expansion itself reads as w_exp = -1 exactly, with no time variation; the Kohn-Sham states are not admissible sources of the a4 equations (Revision/field_equations_a4/reports/ks-source-conditions.json), so no self-consistent history is available (OPEN)

kohn_sham_gas.A_B: w_eff = X/E in [0.2929058677171, 0.3182941676741] (N = 688, lambda = 0): radiation-like, rising toward 1/3; no dark-energy value
kohn_sham_gas.C: w_eff = X/E - 1/3 + (2/3) Pt/E in [-0.0404, -0.0069] (all gas series): close to 0, dust-like; tangent wa in [-0.0178, -0.0090], fitted wa in [-0.0265, -0.0196]; w never near -0.861 or below -1; not the Unite values

unite_comparison.condensate: with b4(x4) the condensate drifts: u = lambda S/m ~ e^(-2 a4); at the u that gives the ratio -0.764 today its wa is -2.6954 (thawing sign), w_eff(A) = (2/3) w_c = -0.5093, w_eff(C) = -1/3 + (2/3) w_c = -0.8427, both with wa = -1.7969
unite_comparison.mixtures: gas + lambda = 0 condensate: w_eff(C) >= -1/3, the Unite values are not reached; gas + a drifting condensate: closest points to (-0.861, -0.60) in the three definitions in mixture_scan (above)
unite_comparison.phantom: w_eff(C) + 1 = X/E + (2/3)(1 + Pt/E): every computed state has X >= 0 and Pt/E >= -1 except the N = 8, lambda > 0 states (E < 0, X = 0, Pt/E in (0.9, 1]): no computed state has w_eff(C) < -1
unite_comparison.label: INTERPRETATION (labelled): the comparison treats the Unite numbers as constraints on the dilution of a 4-dimensional effective density; the Kohn-Sham history is a prescribed background without back-reaction
